notes.title: Major Update: Custom Car Support, New Cars & Enhanced Menu!
notes.content:
Just Drive v0.4.0 is here

This major update brings exciting new features to the game!

Here's what's new and improved:


 Players can now import their own custom cars into the game by preparing models in 3D software like Blender, creating a Godot 4.3 project, and exporting them to the game via PCK files.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/3a9b8a99deeb8fb302bb8d9f4d12f3312a78c754.png

  In addition, 13 new street cars have been added, expanding your driving options.
 We’ve also introduced new car classifications with 'era' and 'class' categories to better organize vehicles.
 The main menu and UI has been revamped.
 You can now see detailed car weight and engine power in the car selection menu.

notes.title: New Drift Mode, Split Screen, and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're thrilled to announce a major update packed with exciting new features as Drift Mode and Split Screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/f29cc1ae2282f18661c61a86f3744f767ffaa29c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/115ef939652fc6c0b2f7664a559f9a8c97b824d4.jpg

Here's what's is this version:

New Features:

 Split Screen Mode: Enjoy racing with friends in the new split screen mode
 Drift Mode: Experience the thrill of drifting with our brand-new Drift mode.
 New Drift Track: To master the art of drifting.
 Drift Camera: Get the perfect angle with the new Drift camera.
 Hood Camera: Immerse yourself in the action with the new Hood camera.
 New Street Cars: Rear-wheel drive models designed for perfect drifting.
 Persistent Camera: Your preferred camera mode is now saved - for both P1 and P2.
 Back to Menu Button: Easily navigate back to the menu from the level info panel.

Improvements:

 Leaderboard entries for the current player are now displayed in a different color for better visibility.

Fixes:

 Tachometer: The tachometer now correctly shows the speed.

Note:

 Score Attack and Fly Attack levels are currently disabled as we work on adjustments to enhance your experience on these levels.


We're committed to continuously improving your gaming experience. Dive into the new Drift mode, take the new cars for a spin, challenge your friends in split screen mode, and enjoy the latest enhancements and fixes.

Happy racing!

notes.title: Just Drive v0.2.0 is now available
notes.content:
Just Drive v0.2.0 Update is Here! Experience Enhanced Driving Fun!

We’ve just released Just Drive v0.2.0 with a fresh and fun driving experience.

What's New in This Version:


 Revamped Vehicle Physics: Enjoy a superior racing experience with our all-new vehicle physics system. Now, you can maintain control at high speeds and experience different grip levels on asphalt, grass, dirt, and sand.

 User-Friendly Input Display: Input key names are now displayed with easy-to-read, friendly names for better clarity.

 Improved Leaderboard UI: We've added background colors to leaderboard entries for improved readability.

 Bug Fixes: Resolved an issue where the game appeared frozen when resetting the car and pausing during a screen fade.

 New Time Attack Track: Challenge yourself with an exciting new track in Time Attack mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/89298ed6a3a624702e9018b11d40ee2aa979be9e.png

notes.title: Just Drive - Just Released
notes.content:
I'm glad to announce that my little racing game made with Godot Engine is now released.
It's great for wasting a little time, to try and get first on the leaderboards or just have some fun.

Currently, the game has three game modes:

TIME ATTACK
Reach the finish line as fast as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/36486bb84d1085b787982c053a7cf7c11fc5f329.gif

SCORE ATTACK
Drive fast, smash blocks, and stay in the air to score as many points as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/eac58e6d95f425ab52683b09822377813fee043e.gif

FLY ATTACK
Stay in the air as much as possible to get high score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/b283ab377beb79fd115152c5fc9751d2bc2d646b.gif


PLAYING ON YOUR CUSTOM MAPS

Yes, Just Drive can easily load your own maps created and exported from Godot Engine. As more stock maps should come into next updates, feel free to try and create your own map, or ask a friend to create one and share it.

Demo map available for download and test at vencious.com/level-tutorials

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/136bce4b0839a500aaad38af5145aa6447f5beab.gif

Full tutorial on vencious.com
